title: ever SCARLEN|V-neck High-Low Satin Wedding Guest Dress with Pockets
descriptionHtml:
Elevate your wedding guest look with this sophisticated satin midi dress. Designed with a flattering V-neckline and short sleeves, this high-low silhouette adds a touch of modern flair. Functional pockets make it as practical as it is stylish, while the smooth satin fabric drapes beautifully to enhance your curves. This versatile dress transitions effortlessly from daytime ceremonies to evening receptions.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises satin.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
